labeller: harness-author (single labeller — inter-rater validation deferred to V2)

reference_A_mechanical.description: Economy lower bound: two notes in position I, one clean shift up to position VIII, two notes there. Exactly one shift; root travel equals the position change, no more.

reference_B_human.description: Acceptance REGION for a single-shift ascending line: one committed move up the neck between note 2 and note 3, the hand settling into the new position; no extra shuffling.

constraints.unused_fingers: tracking the shift, not left behind
